key.name: poll-interval
key.summary: Sensor poll interval in milliseconds

key.name: gpu-poll-interval
key.summary: NVIDIA GPU poll interval in milliseconds

key.name: gpu-enabled
key.summary: Poll the NVIDIA GPU temperature via nvidia-smi

key.name: unit
key.summary: Temperature unit

key.name: decimals
key.summary: Decimal places shown for temperature values

key.name: warn-temp
key.summary: Warning threshold in degrees Celsius

key.name: crit-temp
key.summary: Critical threshold in degrees Celsius

key.name: hidden-sensors
key.summary: Sensor ids hidden everywhere (e.g. sensors reporting bogus values)

key.name: panel-enabled
key.summary: Show the top bar indicator

key.name: panel-sensor
key.summary: Sensor id shown in the top bar; empty means auto-detect the CPU

key.name: panel-show-icon
key.summary: Show the thermometer icon in the top bar

key.name: panel-colorize
key.summary: Colour the top bar reading once it passes the warning threshold

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Top bar box to place the indicator in (left, center or right)

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Position of the indicator within its top bar box

key.name: menu-sensors
key.summary: Sensor ids listed in the popup menu; empty means all visible sensors

key.name: widget-enabled
key.summary: Show the desktop widget

key.name: widget-sensors
key.summary: Ordered sensor ids charted by the desktop widget

key.name: widget-history-seconds
key.summary: Length of chart history in seconds

key.name: widget-width
key.summary: Widget width in logical pixels

key.name: widget-chart-height
key.summary: Height of each chart in logical pixels

key.name: widget-opacity
key.summary: Widget opacity as a percentage

key.name: widget-monitor
key.summary: Monitor index for the widget; -1 means the primary monitor

key.name: widget-anchor
key.summary: Corner the widget offsets are measured from

key.name: widget-x
key.summary: Horizontal offset from the anchor corner

key.name: widget-y
key.summary: Vertical offset from the anchor corner

key.name: widget-show-title
key.summary: Show the widget header

key.name: widget-locked
key.summary: Prevent the widget from being dragged
